run_bench_diffusion_nvfp4_scaled_mm: run the diffusion NVFP4 scaled mm benchmark CLI to benchmark cutlass and flashinfer backends
run_shape_suite: run the benchmark suite for a list of NVFP4 matrix shape cases across cutlass and flashinfer backends
build_quantized_inputs: build NVFP4 quantized matrix inputs for a given MxNxK shape and device seed
benchmark_provider: benchmark a callable function with warmup iterations and return median min max timing
load_shape_cases: load shape cases from a JSON shape library file mapping models to matrix dimensions
